name: Prayer rhythm
summary: Build a daily prayer rhythm with prompts, a weekly theme and a log for answered prayers.

onboarding.prompt: When would you like to pray?
onboarding.reaction: Beautiful. Prompts land at those times.
We'll add family prompts if so.

plan_blueprint.calendar: A daily prompt at each chosen time and a Sunday look-back reminder.

approach_variants.habit: Prayer stacked on an existing moment (first coffee); streak of days.
approach_variants.time: Prayer time as a fixed calendar block.
approach_variants.reward: Answered-prayer log reviewed at each month's end.
approach_variants.resource: First week sets up a journal, a quiet spot and a prayer partner.

guardrails: Prayer requests about other people stay private unless you choose to share them.
Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
restart_rules: A missed day is just the next day; no broken streak shown. After a quiet week, the plan restarts with a short welcome-back prompt.
addon_tracks: Suggested: Faith Promises Scripture Response Guide
